Utpatti-sthity-abhivyakti-vikāra-pratyaya-āptayaḥ /
Viyoga-anyatva-dhṛtayaḥ kāraṇaṃ navadhā smṛtam / iti /
Tatra–utpatti-kāraṇaṃ mano bhavati jñānasya / Sthiti-kāraṇaṃ manasaḥ puruṣa-arthatā,
śarīrasya–iva–āhāra iti / Abhivyatkti-kāraṇaṃ yathā rūpasya–ālokas tathā rūpa-jñānam /
Vikāra-kāraṇaṃ manaso viṣaya-antaram, yathā–agniḥ pākyasya / Pratyaya-kāraṇaṃ dhūma-
jñānam agni-jñānasya / Prāpti-kāraṇaṃ yoga-aṅga-anuṣṭhānaṃ viveka-khyāteḥ / Viyoga-
kāraṇaṃ tad eva–aśuddheḥ / Anyatva-kāraṇaṃ yathā suvarṇasya suvarṇa-kāraḥ / Evam
